note: Rerun attempt switching the LLM backend to the opencode hosted provider (spikes/_llm.py: resolve_provider(), SENTRA_LLM_PROVIDER=opencode or auto-fallback). Smoke test (1 chat() call, 'Reply with exactly: OK', max_tokens=512) failed with HTTP 403 and error type FreeTierError: "OpenCode's free tier can only be used from within OpenCode. Download it at https://opencode.ai and keep building." The gate is server-side and NOT header/stream-related: the identical request with the official client's User-Agent (opencode/latest/2.0.32/cli), x-opencode-client header and stream:true also got 403, and so did an unauthenticated request. On the SAME machine and the SAME account, the official client DOES work: `opencode run -m opencode/glm-5.3-flash-free 'Reply with exactly: OK'` returned 'OK' (CLI v2.0.22), so the auth.json credential (type 'api', a Console API key, sk-*) is what the free-tier gate rejects for non-OpenCode-client requests. Per the opencode-backend run rules (401/403 = systematic auth block, not a per-chunk transient), the run was stopped before any chunk. No cost table exists for the opencode backend; the only valid S5 measurements are the OpenRouter pilot in S5_docgen.json (10/300 chunks) and the previous blocked file S5_docgen_blocked.json.
